meta.name: grill-with-docs
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过追问式对话完善计划或设计，并同步生成 ADR 与术语表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在推进复杂方案时犹豫不决，需要有人帮你挖出逻辑漏洞并留下清晰记录。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pressure-test complex designs and keep a clear decision trail.

howto.what: 它会就你的方案或设计展开一轮持续追问（grilling），并在过程中生成 ADR 和术语表这两类文档。
howto.when: 由你显式调用该技能时触发——原文设定它不会被模型自动调用；典型时机是想打磨一份方案或设计。

say.text: 帮我用 grilling 追问这份设计方案，边问边产出 ADR
say.note: 会持续追问，并生成 ADR 与术语表

say.text: 启动 /grilling，用 domain-modeling 技能打磨我的计划
say.note: 按 grilling 流程追问，同时建立领域术语表

say.text: 继续追问我的架构设计，把每个决策记成 ADR
say.note: 追问继续，决策落成 ADR 文档

howto.what_en: It runs a grilling session that keeps pressing you with questions to sharpen a plan or design, and writes ADRs and a glossary as it goes.
howto.when_en: You invoke it explicitly — the skill is set so the model won't call it on its own. Typical moment: when you want to sharpen a plan or design.

say_en.text: Grill this design with me and produce ADRs as we go.
say_en.note: You get a relentless interview plus ADR and glossary docs.

say_en.text: Start /grilling to sharpen my plan using domain modeling.
say_en.note: Questions plus a domain glossary get produced.

say_en.text: Keep grilling my architecture and log each decision as an ADR.
say_en.note: The interview continues and decisions land as ADRs.
